semiconductor_relevance: Medium — G&S Industrial Co., Ltd. provides specialized filters and equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: G&S Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures filters and equipment for the semiconductor and LCD industries, focusing on liquid and gas filtration, getters, purifiers, and catalysts. The company has established itself as a reliable supplier to major industry players, including Samsung Electronics and Mattson.

regional_presence.Korea: G&S Industrial Co., Ltd. has supplied filters to Samsung Electronics' LCD division since 2006, indicating a strong presence in Korea.
